elgato.cameraHub.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot starts looking after your webcams (you press Connect, or it connects on start). Webcam control only works on Linux for now.

variables.backend: The method Cuebot uses to talk to the webcams, like V4L2

elgato.cameraHub.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot stops looking after your webcams (you press Disconnect, or Cuebot closes the link).

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot finds a webcam that was not there before, for example when you plug one in. Webcam control only works on Linux for now.

fields.device: Which webcam to watch, by the name Cuebot shows, like "Elgato Facecam" (its device path, like /dev/video0, works too). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for every webcam.

variables.devicePath: Where the webcam sits on your computer, like /dev/video0

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setBrightness.description: Changes how bright a webcam's picture is.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: How bright, from 0 (darkest) to 100 (brightest). With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setContrast.description: Changes the contrast of a webcam's picture (the gap between dark and light parts).

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: How much contrast, from 0 to 100. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setSaturation.description: Changes how strong the colors are in a webcam's picture.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: How strong, from 0 (gray) to 100 (very colorful). With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setSharpness.description: Changes how sharp the edges look in a webcam's picture.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Sharpness in the camera's own steps. The Elgato Facecam goes from 0 to 4. With Adjustment ticked, how many steps to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setFocus.description: Moves a webcam's focus, which makes things nearer or farther look sharp.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Focus from 0 to 100. Turn auto focus off first, or the camera may refuse. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setPan.description: Moves a webcam's picture left or right.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Position from 0 to 100, where 50 is the middle. It only moves while zoomed in. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setTilt.description: Moves a webcam's picture up or down.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Position from 0 to 100, where 50 is the middle. It only moves while zoomed in. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setWhiteBalance.description: Changes how warm (orange) or cool (blue) a webcam's colors look.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Number in Kelvin, like 5000. The Facecam goes from 2800 to 12500. Turn auto white balance off first. With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setZoom.description: Zooms a webcam in or out.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.value: Zoom from 100 (widest) to 400 (closest). With Adjustment ticked, how much to add or take away.
fields.adjustment: Tick to add your number to the current setting instead of replacing it. Use a negative number to go down, like -10.

variables.webcamValue: The new value of the first webcam that was changed

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setAutoWhiteBala.description: Turns a webcam's auto white balance on or off (the camera picks the color warmth itself).

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.mode: Enabled turns it on, Disabled turns it off, Toggle flips it to the opposite of what it is now.

variables.webcamValue: true if auto white balance is on after the change, false if it is off (first webcam changed)

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setAutoFocus.description: Turns a webcam's auto focus on or off (the camera keeps things sharp itself).

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.mode: Enabled turns it on, Disabled turns it off, Toggle flips it to the opposite of what it is now.

variables.webcamValue: true if auto focus is on after the change, false if it is off (first webcam changed)

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setAutoExposure.description: Turns a webcam's auto exposure on or off (the camera picks the brightness itself).

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.mode: Enabled turns it on, Disabled turns it off, Toggle flips it to the opposite of what it is now.

variables.webcamValue: true if auto exposure is on after the change, false if it is off (first webcam changed)

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.setAntiFlicker.description: Sets a webcam's anti-flicker, which stops lamps from flickering on camera.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.
fields.antiFlicker: Pick 50 Hz or 60 Hz to match the electricity where you live (50 in most of Europe, 60 in the US). Auto lets the camera choose. Off turns it off.

elgato.cameraHub.webcam.getSettings.description: Reads a webcam's current settings into variables you can use in later steps.

fields.device: Which webcam to change, by name, like "Elgato Facecam". Separate several with commas, or type All for every webcam. Empty means the first webcam Cuebot found.

variables.devicePath: Where the webcam sits on your computer, like /dev/video0
variables.sharpness: Sharpness, in the camera's own steps
variables.zoomValue: Zoom as a number (100 is widest)
variables.zoomPercent: Zoom with a percent sign, like 150%
variables.autoFocus: true if auto focus is on
variables.autoWhiteBalance: true if auto white balance is on
variables.autoExposure: true if auto exposure is on
variables.antiFlicker: Anti-flicker setting: Off, 50 Hz, 60 Hz or Auto
variables.mirrored: true if the picture is mirrored
variables.flipped: true if the picture is upside down
